title: 第8章 磨剑堂第9章 魔鬼训练

第008章 磨剑堂
唐安突然感到小腹中涌起一股奇怪的气团，气团按照一定的规律旋转不停。可是等他想要去控制那些气团的时候，气团却顿时消失了，气团上的那些内气也通过经脉四散到身体里去了。
顿时，他只感觉到浑身一阵轻松，三天来的疲惫瞬间一扫而光。
“天人第一重，练气养生，果然神奇！”
唐安拍了拍衣角站起身来，就那么一下子，他就觉得自己的身体轻松了许多，精神也好了不少。
“果然，练武之人和普通人确实有着本质的区别！”
“还磨蹭什么？难道你们都不想吃饭了吗？快去排队！”就在这时，一道严厉的声音传来。顿时，小屁孩们都被吓了一跳，急忙把翻的乱七八糟的包裹一股脑的塞进去，重新背在自己身上。
“上路！”
【磨剑堂】占地近千亩，位于蜀山半山腰的一处奇怪的平台上，自古便是蜀山外门弟子修炼之地。传说这半山腰的平台乃是蜀山剑派创始人长眉真人一剑削出来的。若是换做以前，唐安或许听过便只笑笑，人力哪能达到这种境界？可是现在，他却不能肯定。
【磨剑堂】的磨剑之意，寓意明显。蜀山乃是剑派，弟子自然是江湖上的绝世剑客。工欲善其事，必先利其器。磨剑磨剑，心中那柄剑若是锋利无比，手上就算只是普通凡兵，也能发挥莫大威力。
中午排队吃了一顿粗粮，不过唐安却没有感到倒胃口，反而觉得滋味不错。那些食物一入体内，唐安就感觉到自己丹田处的内气不由自主的运转了起来，将那些食物消耗掉，然后化成营养，被人体吸收。
“原来如此！练气养生，想必就是通过饮食吸收能量，再通过睡眠让大脑获得充分的休息，使得人体精力充沛，再配合内气循环，将这些精力能量良好的储存起来，修养身体，让身体时刻处在最佳状态。如此良性循环之下，怕是要不了多久，人体内的有害物质都会一一被生理调节清除出去，身体达到一定的条件，便会进入天人第二重境界！”
中午那些食物吃起来虽然恶心倒胃口，可是唐安仔细回想起来，那些食物里似乎含有很多药物。毕竟他从小就是体弱多病，吃的药比吃饭还多，对于药味极为敏感。
午饭过后，新进门的千余名弟子就被安排到了各自的房间里休息。这千余人中有一半以上都只能举起50斤的石锁，若是三月之后不能通过考核，那么必然被赶出蜀山，从此，沦为江湖底层。因为被蜀山赶出门外，意味着其他大门派也不会收他们！哪个大门派会收下从蜀山淘汰出来的废物？那不是扇自己的脸，证明自己门派比蜀山差吗？江湖中人行事，面子第一，谁也丢不起这个脸！
那些小屁孩们也知道自己的处境，也不敢胡乱浪费时间，一吃过午饭都匆匆跑出去寻觅空地煅炼自己的身体。毕竟练出气感可不是一天两天的事情，在这之前，身体煅炼也不能放松。
唐安没有同那些小屁孩出去煅炼身体，因为他刚刚已经修炼出了气感，虽然不知道是什么原因。但是他能确定，自己确实是修炼出了气感。不过他还是不放心，跑到外面找了一块差不多50斤重量的石头。
他深吸一口气，双手敞开，牢牢扣住那块大石块。嘴里“喝”的大叫一声。他的手臂一用力，瞬间就感觉到丹田处的气旋飞速旋转起来，沿着经脉朝手臂涌来，顿时，他便感到了自己的手臂充满了力量。
“啊！”他猛地将那巨石举过了头顶，重重的往外一甩。石块砸在地面上，“嘭”的一声闷响，将地面砸进去一块凹陷！
“我成功了！哈哈……”唐安此时更是抑制不住自己心中的喜悦，大笑起来。举起50斤的巨石，这代表他终于踏出了成为高手的第一步！50斤的巨石，换在以前，他是绝对做不到的！
不过唐安笑了一会儿，却忽然听到一道冷哼从自己背后传来。

“得意什么？不过就是块50斤大小的石头，我一只手都能举起来，哼！”
唐安转头一看，看到背后站着一个长得很健壮的小屁孩，他的脸蛋很俊美，可是他看人的眼神总透着股阴厉，让人心里发寒，神色实在是像极了那个王公子！
唐安被人嘲笑了一句，心里虽然不高兴，可是他可不会同七八岁的小屁孩计较这些。他拍拍手，又掸了掸自己的衣服，慢悠悠的朝自己的房间走去。也不管那小屁孩在后头怎么鄙视自己。
可是那小屁孩看到唐安无视自己，眼神却陡然冒出怒火，脸色也一下子阴沉了下来：“你竟敢无视我的话？找死！”那个小屁孩尖声叫嚷着，猛的一抬腿，朝唐安踢来。
唐安背对着他，完全没有料到对方居然一言不合就动手开打。他此时只感到背后一阵劲风吹过，可是他想躲却是来不及了。
“嘭！”
那一脚正好踹到了唐安的后背心，踹的极重，唐安只感觉到心口就像被锤子砸了一下，“咚”的停了一下。他的重心不稳，脚下一个趔趄，便朝前方扑去。他的身前正好有一块尖石头，尖锐处磕到他的下巴，顿时划开了一条长长的口子，鲜血顿时飙射出来。
他感到下巴酸麻，便抹了一把，低头一看，手上竟然鲜血淋漓！
他心头涌起一股强烈的怒火！
他爬起身来，全身气的发抖，脸色更是铁青，也不做声，只后脚猛的一蹬，便如离弦之箭朝那小屁孩冲去，只一瞬间，便到了那个小屁孩身前。
那个小屁孩对自己那一脚极为得意，看到唐安的下巴磕破了，鲜血不停地掉在地上，他的心里便更加高兴。可是只一眨眼间，他便看到一个肉嘟嘟的拳头朝自己冲来。他的眼里闪过一丝惊恐。不过就在这时，一个人影从外闪出，手上一推，唐安便“嘭”的再次摔了出去。
是那个王公子！
唐安拳头落空，又被那个王公子手上一推，巨大的惯性顿时让他控制不住身体，猛地朝前扑飞了出去。他的下巴再次磕到了地上，泥沙混着鲜血，磨破了的皮子，夹在了一起。
心头的屈辱，更痛！
“小弟，你没事吧？怎么跟这种废物动手？简直丢了我们王家的脸！”那王公子眼神阴冷的看了唐安一眼，随即皱着眉头看向自己的弟弟。
那个小屁孩对着王公子尴尬的笑笑：“大哥，你怎么来了？是爹找我吗？”他虽然嘴上在说话，可是眼睛却得意的瞥着躺在地上的唐安。
那个小屁孩看到唐安那愤怒的眼神，更加高兴了，他忍不住哈哈大笑起来。看到唐安挣扎了几次，却仍然爬不起来，那个小屁孩笑的更加肆无忌惮了。
“废物！就凭你也敢跟我王锋动手？简直是自寻死路！”说完，那个小屁孩狠狠地朝着地上“呸”的吐了一口口水，便大步朝外走去。
而那个王公子在一边，却只是怜爱的揉了揉自己弟弟的脑袋，显然对于这种事已经习惯了！
唐安趴在地上，他的膝盖已经磕破了，血流如注，殷虹的鲜血透过裤子，渗到了泥土里去。他的双手紧紧握住了拳头，指甲都快渗进肉里，他也浑然不觉得痛，只因他心头怒火中烧！

唐安挣扎着爬起身来，对着那个小屁孩的背影在心底狠狠发誓：“王锋，王锐！我唐安发誓，今日之辱，他日必定百倍相报！王家，我那种眼神看人！
“三月之后的考核，不仅仅是正式确定外门弟子的资格。而且，所有的外门弟子还有机会获得进入蜀山内门的测试资格！到时候，以那个王锋的嚣张肯定会报名参加，我要一血耻辱，就要在所有人面前将你打得像狗一样，爬不起来。这三个月，我一定要抓紧时间，好好修炼！”
唐安抹了一把自己下巴上的泥沙，又将膝盖上的伤口擦拭干净，慢慢的朝着自己的房间走去。远处的山门处，【磨剑堂】三个大字，被晚来的红霞映照的熠熠生辉！
何为磨剑？不仅是要将钝剑磨得锋利，更重要的是，确定一柄剑有没有成为绝世好剑的资格！
若是剑被磨断了，那么即便它再锋利，它也只能成为一把废剑。
归宿，也只有剑冢！
世界上有很多人是变态，无疑，这王家兄弟就是。原因，后续会有说明。

Chapter 008 Sword Grinding Hall
Tang An suddenly felt a strange air mass surge up in his lower abdomen, and the air mass kept spinning according to a certain pattern. But when he tried to control those air masses, the air masses disappeared immediately, and the internal energy on the air masses also dispersed into the body through the meridians.
Suddenly, he felt a wave of relief all over his body, and the fatigue of the past three days was instantly wiped away.
"The first level of heaven and earth, practicing qi and maintaining health is indeed magical!"
Tang An patted the corner of his clothes and stood up. In just a moment, he felt that his body was much lighter and his spirit was much better.
"Sure enough, there is an essential difference between martial arts practitioners and ordinary people!"
"Why are you still lingering? Don't you all want to eat? Go and line up!" At this moment, a stern voice came. Suddenly, the little kids were startled. They hurriedly stuffed the messy packages inside and carried them on their backs again.
"Get on the road!"
[Mojian Hall] covers an area of nearly a thousand acres and is located on a strange platform halfway up Shushan Mountain. It has been the training place for Shushan outer sect disciples since ancient times. Legend has it that the platform halfway up the mountain was carved out by Chang Mei Zhenren, the founder of the Shushan Sword Sect, with a sword. If it were in the past, Tang An might just smile after hearing this. How can human beings reach this level? But now, he is not sure.
[Mojian Tang] means sharpening swords, and the meaning is obvious. Shushan is a sword sect, and its disciples are naturally peerless swordsmen in the world. If a worker wants to do his job well, he must first sharpen his tools. Sharpen your sword and sharpen your sword. If the sword in your heart is extremely sharp, even an ordinary soldier in your hand can exert great power.
We queued up for a meal of whole grains at noon, but Tang An didn't feel unappetizing. Instead, he thought it tasted good. As soon as the food entered the body, Tang An felt the internal energy in his Dantian move involuntarily, consuming the food, then turning it into nutrients and being absorbed by the body.
"That's it! Practicing qi to maintain health must be to absorb energy through diet, and then let the brain get sufficient rest through sleep, so that the human body is full of energy, and then cooperate with the circulation of internal qi to store these energy and cultivate the body, so that the body is always in the best condition. Under such a virtuous cycle, I am afraid that it won't be long before the harmful substances in the human body will be eliminated one by one by physiological regulation. When the body reaches certain conditions, it will enter the second realm of heaven and man!"
Although the food at noon tasted disgusting and unappetizing, Tang An thought about it carefully and found that the food seemed to contain a lot of medicine. After all, he had been frail and sickly since he was a child. He took more medicine than food and was extremely sensitive to the smell of medicine.
After lunch, the more than a thousand new disciples who entered the door were arranged to rest in their respective rooms. More than half of these more than a thousand people can only lift a 50-pound stone lock. If they fail to pass the test after three months, they will be driven out of Shushan and will be reduced to the bottom of the world. Because being kicked out by Shushan means that other sects will not accept them! Which sect would accept the waste eliminated from Shushan? Doesn't that slap yourself in the face to prove that your sect is worse than Shushan? When people in the world of martial arts act, face comes first, and no one can afford to lose this face!
Those little kids also knew their situation and did not dare to waste time. As soon as they had lunch, they hurried out to find an open space to exercise their bodies. After all, developing the sense of Qi is not something that happens in a day or two. Before that, you cannot relax while exercising your body.
Tang An didn't go out to exercise with those little brats because he had just developed the sense of Qi, although he didn't know why. But he was certain that he had indeed cultivated Qi Sense. However, he was still worried and ran outside to find a stone weighing almost 50 kilograms.
He took a deep breath, opened his hands, and firmly grasped the big stone. He yelled "drink" in his mouth. As soon as he exerted force on his arm, he instantlyHe felt the cyclone in his Dantian spinning rapidly and rushing towards his arm along the meridians. Suddenly, he felt that his arm was full of power.
"Ah!" He suddenly lifted the boulder over his head and swung it out hard. The stone hit the ground with a muffled "bang" sound, causing a dent in the ground!
"I succeeded! Haha..." Tang An couldn't restrain the joy in his heart and laughed. Lifting a 50-pound boulder means that he has finally taken the first step to becoming a master! He would never have been able to lift a 50-pound boulder before!
However, Tang An laughed for a while and suddenly heard a cold snort coming from behind him.
"What are you so proud of? It's just a 50-pound stone. I can lift it with one hand, hum!"
Tang An turned around and saw a very strong little kid standing behind him. His face was very handsome, but his eyes always looked at people with a sinister look, which made people feel chilly. He looked very much like that prince!
Tang An was laughed at. Although he was unhappy, he would not care about this with a seven or eight-year-old kid. He clapped his hands, dusted his clothes, and walked slowly toward his room. No matter how much that little brat despises him later.
But when the little kid saw Tang An ignoring him, his eyes suddenly became angry, and his face suddenly darkened: "How dare you ignore my words? You are looking for death!" The little kid screamed, raised his leg fiercely, and kicked Tang An.
Tang An turned his back to him, completely unaware that the other party would start fighting at the slightest disagreement. At this time, he only felt a strong wind blowing behind him, but it was too late for him to hide.
"Bang!"
That kick happened to hit Tang An's back vest, and the kick was so hard that Tang An felt as if his heart had been hit by a hammer, and it stopped for a moment with a "thud". His center of gravity was unstable, his feet staggered, and he threw himself forward. There happened to be a sharp stone in front of him. The sharp point hit his chin, and a long gash was opened immediately, and blood spurted out.
He felt his chin was sore and numb, so he wiped it, and when he looked down, his hand was dripping with blood!
A strong anger surged in his heart!
He got up, his whole body was trembling with anger, his face was livid, and he remained silent. With a sharp kick of his back foot, he rushed towards the little kid like an arrow from the string. In just a moment, he was in front of the little kid.
The little kid was extremely proud of his kick. When he saw Tang An's chin was broken and blood kept falling to the ground, he felt even more happy. But in just a blink of an eye, he saw a fleshy fist rushing towards him. There was a flash of panic in his eyes. But at this moment, a figure flashed out from outside. With a push from his hand, Tang An fell out again with a bang.
It's that prince!
Tang An's fist missed, and he was pushed by the prince's hand. The huge inertia suddenly made him unable to control his body, and he flew forward suddenly. His chin hit the ground again, mud and sand mixed with blood, and the torn leather were caught together.
The humiliation in my heart hurts even more!
"Brother, are you okay? Why do you do anything with this kind of waste? It's a disgrace to our Wang family!" The prince glanced at Tang An with a cold look, then frowned and looked at his brother.
The little kid smiled awkwardly at Prince Wang: "Brother, why are you here? Is dad looking for me?" Although he was talking, his eyes were proudly glancing at Tang An who was lying on the ground.
The little kid became even happier when he saw Tang An's angry eyes, and he couldn't help laughing. Seeing that Tang An struggled several times but still couldn't get up, the little kid laughed even more unscrupulously.
"Trash! You dare to fight with me, Wang Feng? You are simply asking for death!" After saying that, the little brat fiercely faced the ground.He spat "Bah" and strode outside.
The prince, on the other hand, just rubbed his brother's head lovingly. Apparently he was used to this kind of thing!
Tang An was lying on the ground, his knees were bruised and bleeding profusely. Yin Hong's blood seeped through his pants and into the soil. His hands clenched his fists so tightly that his nails almost penetrated into his flesh. He didn't feel any pain at all, just because he was so angry!
Tang An struggled to get up and swore fiercely at the little kid's back: "Wang Feng, Wang Rui! I, Tang An, swear that today's humiliation will be repaid a hundred times in the future! Wang family, I look at people like that!
“The assessment after March will not only formally determine the qualifications of the outer disciples. Moreover, all outer sect disciples will also have the opportunity to obtain the test qualifications to enter the inner sect of Shushan! When the time comes, with Wang Feng's arrogance, he will definitely sign up to participate. If I want to be humiliated, I will beat you like a dog in front of everyone and you will be unable to get up. In these three months, I must seize the time and practice hard! "
Tang An wiped the sand on his chin, wiped the wounds on his knees clean, and slowly walked towards his room. At the mountain gate in the distance, the three characters [Mojian Hall] were shining brightly in the late red glow!
Why sharpen a sword? It’s not just about sharpening a dull sword, but more importantly, it’s about determining whether a sword has the qualifications to become a great sword!
If a sword is worn off, no matter how sharp it is, it can only become a useless sword.
The only destination is Sword Tomb!
There are many people in the world who are perverts, and undoubtedly these Wang brothers are. The reason will be explained later.
